description:
For the country lover, boho chic in all of us!

Beautiful centrally located townhome in the iconic West End area! So close to everything.  West End turns into Broadway, downtown is a 6 minute drive! Music Row is 5 minutes! 
The highways are 1 minute away! 

Enjoy the shopping, cafes, eating that West End has to offer! Check out the parthenon! 6 minutes to downtown! 4 minutes to midtown!

This is a very peaceful and quiet residential area with such easy access to all the city has to offer.

The space
Two Story Townhome with a boho fewl!

First Floor:
->Spacious living area w/ twin bed + Roku TV
-> 4 person pub table
->half bath
->Full Kitchen

Second Floor:
->TWO Queen Bedrooms w/ ensuite baths and closets. Roku TV's too!
-> Laundry

Outdoor Patio + Games!

*please note these townhomes are not new builds, they are from the late 80s and hold some character still from then!

Guest access
Check in via a keypad. Please note our check in hours are 3pm-9pm, this is when we are avaliable for assistance but you're welcome to check in after also!

Other things to note
There is one parking space included with the unit. It is directly in front of the unit. There is first come first serve parking also on the premise.
